text:
carmen (People Ops): heads-up - post-export issue. The weekly anonymized hiring export just ran and it looks like submitted_by on ~24 panels got replaced with 'anon-collector' instead of just removing names. Now hiring owners aren't receiving notification and panels show no owner.
ravi (Recruiting Ops): confirmed. Candidates' feedback exist but ownership is blank, can we reassign? I counted 24 panels across eng and product.
zoe (Data - Research): that was our job. we ran the anonymize-export job export-2026-07-21 with --anonymize. our intent was to remove interviewer names/emails, not interviewer IDs. Looks like the sed rule was overly broad. example bad line: `s/"interviewer": \".*\"/"interviewer": "anon-collector"/g` - that clobbered the id and the handle.
li (Eng - Backend): ouch. our routing uses `submitted_by` to send post-interview notifications and to lock ownership on scorecards. If that field is changed to non-existent user the notification flow drops. We also have a safety that prevents reassignment if submitted_by is not a valid user, so panels are in limbo.
export-bot: job export-2026-07-21 completed status=success rows=412 anonymize=true rule=sed-overwrite id=exp-7723
zoe (Data - Research): i'm really sorry. immediate plan: (1) halt downstream publish (we paused the export feed) (2) restore a copy of the pre-anonymized export and generate a delta for the 24 affected panels (restore id rs-880) (3) re-run anonymize with a targeted rule that only replaces `name` and `email` fields, keeping `interviewer_id` and `handle` intact.
carmen (People Ops): thanks. we need a manual recovery path too - hiring owners need notifications asap. ravi, can recruiting ops take first pass at reassigning owners for panels scheduled this week?
ravi (Recruiting Ops): yes, i'll triage the 24 panels and reassign where possible. For ones we can't map automatically I'll DM the hiring owners. Also adding a checklist item: don't accept anonymized export unless `submitted_by` and `panel_owner_id` preserved.
li (Eng - Backend): action items from infra side: (A) add schema validation at publish step to reject exports that null or rewrite required fields (`submitted_by`, `panel_id`, `candidate_id`) (B) add a 'dry-run' flag to anonymize job that emits a report of fields touched. I'll push a patch and a monitor to detect non-user values in `submitted_by`.
scorecard-service-bot: queued job mark-ownership-issue id=mark-224 will tag affected panels as "ownership-missing" and notify hiring owners.
zoe (Data - Research): restoration plan: restored export rs-880 available, will produce corrected anonymized export by 14:30 UTC and post here with diff. Also adding the exact sed replacement I'll use in case you want to review:
```
# good rule: only redact name and email fields, keep ids
sed -E 's/("name":\s*")[^"]+("),/\1REDACTED\2,/g; s/("email":\s*")[^"]+(@[^"]+)("),/\1redacted\2\3,/g'
```
(Note: this preserves interviewer handles/ids.)
carmen (People Ops): perfect. once corrected export is ready please ping here and we'll confirm notifications. Also please add an item to the runbook: "anonymize exports must pass schema validation and dry-run review".
ravi (Recruiting Ops): triage kickoff: i'll go through panels with decisions due in 48h first and ping owners.
li (Eng - Backend): validation patch pushed; monitor added (alert if exported `submitted_by` not in user directory). Also added a fail-fast if anonymize job touches `interviewer_id` or `panel_owner_id`.
export-bot: corrected export exp-7723-rerun completed status=success rows=412 anonymize=false (interview ids preserved) rerun id=exp-7723-fix
zoe (Data - Research): rerun done and validated. diff shows 24 rows had interviewer field changed; fixed now. attaching diff id diff-224 (internal).
scorecard-service-bot: mark-ownership-issue completed: 24 panels tagged, owners notified where mapping succeeded (12), 12 pending manual review.
carmen (People Ops): thanks team. closing loop for now. ravi and i will work offline on manual reassignments; reopen if more anomalies show up. :white_check_mark:
